result.title: RSReasoner: Reformulating and Auditing Geospatial Reasoning Segmentation
result.summary: Geospatial reasoning segmentation aims to localize geographic targets from language requiring semantic inference beyond direct visual perception. However, existing benchmarks often operationalize reasoning as category omission while overlooking attribute mixing, which neglects explicit-category reasoning, introduces perceptual shortcuts, and fails to precisely evaluate reasoning capability. To diagnose and address these limitations, we first reformulate geospatial reasoning segmentation along category expression (explicit vs. implicit) and attribute nature (perceptual vs. inferential), and audit 90,708 queries across existing benchmarks to reveal that pure explicit-inferential queries account for only 0.61% whereas 31.98% mix both attribute types. We then develop a three-stage pipeline that harnesses OpenStreetMap attributes while mitigating geometric and semantic noise to construct RSReasoner, a large-scale dataset of 106,610 images with 213,220 reasoning queries, and RSReasoner-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 75,400 queries across four canonical types and controlled variants. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSReasoner-Bench precisely evaluates model capability across multiple dimensions while exposing shortcut behaviors, and fine-tuning on RSReasoner boosts both reasoning and cross-type generalization. Our findings offer key insights for future geospatial reasoning research and benchmark design. Datasets and code will be released at https://github.com/Ricardo-XZ/RSReasoner.

AI.brief_summary: 该文重构地理空间推理分割的任务定义，按类别表达（显式/隐式）与属性性质（感知/推理）两个维度审计 90,708 条现有查询，并借助 OpenStreetMap 属性构建大规模数据集 RSReasoner 与诊断基准 RSReasoner-Bench，用于检验模型是真正推理还是走感知捷径。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「感知属性和推理属性混杂、显式类别缺失导致知觉捷径」的诊断思路，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和推理能力是否被真正使用有具体联系，但其地理分割任务与内部 latent 状态机制相距较远，值得核查其捷径分析与控制变量设计能否迁移。
